description: What the workflows behind a PRIORITY could become, at five levels (Assist, Automate, Re-form, Invert, Dissolve): for each, whether it fits, is already reached, or what it needs; what changes; what it does to the priority; time freed; and the change made from it, if any. Also the recommended level, or `settled` when the work is good as it is. state 'running' means a read is under way; null means none has been read (compass_transformations_read starts one).
